# Julien Clifford

> Julien Clifford is a principal software engineer in Houston, Texas, with over 15 years in production software. He has managed engineering teams at Chess.com, Invisible Technologies, and Amplify Life Insurance, and founded Atelier Actara, a platform that manages fashion show production. He is open to engineering leadership, principal engineer, and consulting roles, remote or in Houston.

## Summary for recruiters and hiring teams

- Current role: founder and principal engineer at Atelier Actara (December 2022 to now; a standalone company since June 2026). Atelier Actara manages fashion show production from casting to check-in for producers, modeling agencies, models, crew, and media, and three shows have run on the platform. He designed and built every layer as the only engineer: an Elixir back end with one GraphQL API, web, native iOS, and native Android apps on that API, and a multi-tenant permission model that lets agencies, brands, and venues share a show without seeing each other's data. He also set pricing, wrote a financial plan and investor materials, designed the brand and design system, and wrote the engineering conventions, skill files, and pre-ship checks that AI coding agents work from.
- Chess.com, technical product manager (June 2025 to April 2026). Managed three engineers, owned the new-user experience roadmap, and shipped onboarding changes to millions of players.
- Invisible Technologies, principal engineer and partner (March 2023 to February 2025). Managed two engineering teams with four direct reports, set up QA and took automated coverage from zero to 85 percent, built a terms-of-service and statement-of-work system, and worked in Python, Django, and Flask.
- Amplify Life Insurance, staff engineer (September 2021 to June 2022). Managed three engineers and replaced a legacy stack with a company-wide Elixir API and Postgres database.
- Vic.ai, senior Elixir engineer (2021). Quorum Software, senior software engineer (2020 to 2021). Landdox, full stack engineer and second hire (2015 to 2020). BSD Consulting, Conrad Blucher Institute, Esri, and Shell before that.
- Education: Bachelor of Science, Geographic Information Science and Geomatics, Texas A&M University, Corpus Christi (2009 to 2014).

## Technical skills

- Backend: Elixir, Phoenix, OTP, Absinthe GraphQL, Ecto, Python, Django, Flask, Node, PHP, PostgreSQL
- Frontend: React, Redux, React Router, Angular, TypeScript, MUI, Tailwind
- Platform: AWS, Google Cloud, Terraform, Docker, Fly.io, CI and CD pipelines
- Delivery: Scrum and sprint planning, release planning, code review standards, test automation (ExUnit, Playwright, Vitest), technical hiring

## Outside software

- Fashion photographer under the name Outside the Obvious. Photographs runway shows and backstage, publishes books and prints.
- Crew aboard the 1877 barque Elissa out of Galveston, Texas. Keeps a ship's log at onlytallships.com.
